import sys

MOD = 1000000007

class ModInt:
    __slots__ = ('v',)
    def __init__(self, v=0):
        self.v = v % MOD
    def __add__(self, other):
        if isinstance(other, ModInt):
            return ModInt(self.v + other.v)
        return ModInt(self.v + other)
    def __radd__(self, other):
        return ModInt(self.v + other)
    def __iadd__(self, other):
        if isinstance(other, ModInt):
            self.v = (self.v + other.v) % MOD
        else:
            self.v = (self.v + other) % MOD
        return self
    def __mul__(self, other):
        if isinstance(other, ModInt):
            return ModInt(self.v * other.v)
        return ModInt(self.v * other)
    def __rmul__(self, other):
        return ModInt(self.v * other)
    def __imul__(self, other):
        if isinstance(other, ModInt):
            self.v = (self.v * other.v) % MOD
        else:
            self.v = (self.v * other) % MOD
        return self
    def __pow__(self, exp):
        return ModInt(pow(self.v, exp, MOD))
    def __truediv__(self, other):
        if isinstance(other, ModInt):
            inv = pow(other.v, MOD-2, MOD)
        else:
            inv = pow(other, MOD-2, MOD)
        return ModInt(self.v * inv)
    def __repr__(self):
        return str(self.v)
    def __eq__(self, other):
        if isinstance(other, ModInt):
            return self.v == other.v
        return self.v == other
    def __hash__(self):
        return hash(self.v)

def solve() -> None:
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    N = next(it)
    P = [[next(it) for _ in range(N)] for _ in range(N)]

    # G: bitset -> ModInt, initial bitset has bit 0 set (mask 0)
    G = {1: ModInt(1)}

    for i in range(N):
        H = {}
        for bits, val in G.items():
            S = []
            for m in range(1 << N):
                if (bits >> m) & 1:
                    S.append(m)
            H[tuple(S)] = val
        G.clear()

        # Precompute pst for each j (column mask)
        for j in range(1 << N):
            pst = ModInt(1)
            for k in range(N):
                if (j >> k) & 1:
                    pst *= P[i][k]
                else:
                    pst *= 100 - P[i][k]

            for S_tup, val in H.items():
                ans_bits = 0
                for l in range(N):
                    if (j >> l) & 1:
                        for m in S_tup:
                            if not ((m >> l) & 1):
                                ans_bits |= 1 << (m | (1 << l))
                if ans_bits != 0:
                    G[ans_bits] = G.get(ans_bits, ModInt(0)) + val * pst

    total = ModInt(0)
    for v in G.values():
        total += v

    inv100 = ModInt(pow(100, MOD-2, MOD))
    for _ in range(N * N):
        total *= inv100

    print(total)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
